BackstoryDef.title: academy cadet
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] entered the academy at eight and was inventoried, uniformed, scheduled and drilled until the rough edges — curiosity, mostly — were sanded off. [PAWN_pronoun] can still fold a bunk to regulation in the dark, and part of [PAWN_objective] still finds sirens restful.

BackstoryDef.title: garrison brat
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed a parent's postings from garrison to garrison — a new world every two years, a new language in the market, the same grey walls inside. [PAWN_pronoun] belonged to the Empire the way luggage belongs to a ship: carried everywhere, at home nowhere, and easier to leave behind than anyone expected.

BackstoryDef.title: stormtrooper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in white armor under a designation, one of ten thousand identical silhouettes. [PAWN_pronoun] holds formation under fire, follows orders without editorializing, and grieves dead comrades briefly and in private — the armor teaches you that the person beside you is replaceable, and so are you.

BackstoryDef.title: requisitions officer
BackstoryDef.description: Armies run on forms, and [PAWN_nameDef] was the person the forms feared. [PAWN_pronoun] can inventory a warehouse by walking through it, find the theft in a clean-looking ledger, and requisition anything from anywhere given three signatures and a little patience. Disorder offends [PAWN_objective] professionally.

BackstoryDef.title: imperial deserter
BackstoryDef.description: One order, somewhere, was finally too much, and [PAWN_nameDef] walked away from the Empire with a stolen rifle and a death mark. [PAWN_pronoun] knows Imperial doctrine from the inside — the patrol patterns, the codes, the paperwork — and knows exactly what the retrieval squad will do if it ever finds [PAWN_objective]. It will not be a rescue.

BackstoryDef.title: palace-raised
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in an oasis palace where the fountains ran while the city outside queued for ration-water. [PAWN_pronoun] learned music, poison etiquette, and which guests rank above which — and acquired a permanent, quiet conviction that comfort is simply how things ought to be.

BackstoryDef.title: debt-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was collateral before [PAWN_pronoun] could talk: born into a family ledger the Cartel never lets reach zero. Every meal was an entry, every kindness had interest. [PAWN_pronoun] works like the debt is still open — because somewhere, in some book, it is.

BackstoryDef.title: majordomo
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood at a Hutt's right hand and translated appetite into administration. [PAWN_pronoun] ran the palace, priced the favors, soothed the offended and scheduled the disappearances, all in perfect courtesy. People who understand what [PAWN_pronoun] knows tend to pay very well to have [PAWN_objective] back.

BackstoryDef.title: collection enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] collected what the Cartel was owed, and the Cartel is always owed. Mostly [PAWN_pronoun] never had to touch anyone — standing quietly in a doorway does remarkable things to a debtor's memory. When standing quietly was not enough, [PAWN_pronoun] was competent at the other thing too.

BackstoryDef.title: spice-runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] flew the routes that do not appear on charts, with cargo nobody declared, on schedules set by people nobody refuses. [PAWN_pronoun] is superb under pressure and allergic to questions — and there are nights, still, when the old cargo whispers that one taste would settle [PAWN_possessive] nerves right down.
